description.text: The Hakugyukurou Keepstar is a massive military orbital station standing at the entry point into the territory of the CSSF. Its main responsibility is to keep an eye on the nearby wormhole to Hiljaak to keep the SPA's plushie dealers out.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is heavily militaristic, with soldiers and their equipment everywhere. The scanning procedures at this station are extremely invasive. The scanning procedures grow ever more complicated as it attempts to win the arms race against the plushie smugglers.

description.text: Aside from that, a majority of the ring appears to be empty and dark, illuminated only by the sun it surrounds. The CSSF isn't really that large, after all.

spaceport.text: The spaceport resides to the left of the only populated sector of the ring. It is massive, with traders entering and exiting near-constantly. As you go further left, all you see are countless numbers of large ships, presumably a ship parking lot.

name: Ring of Gensokyo
_internalId: Lemurias Extra ES Stuff/Lemurias-Extra-ES-Stuff::Ring of Gensokyo

description.text: The Liminal Bastion is yet another urban colony within CSSF territory. It is populated by roughly 3.1 million people. Long before the arrival of the CSSF, Liminal Bastion had been an independent colony, until it voluntarily joined in 2941.

spaceport.text: Liminal Bastion's spaceport is old. Dating back to the 2700s, it has been built, destroyed, and rebuilt multiple times. It is a sprawling mess that is closely integrated with the planet's only city and it is common for previously undiscovered sections that were never in the blueprints to be uncovered during a routine maintenance operation.

description.text: The Geidontei Fortress is another massive military base. Military infastructure dominates on this planet, with the sight of civilians very rare. The massive fleet defenses here ensure that any plushie smuggler will have a hard time transporting plushies past this system.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is full of soldiers and large turrets, some of which are pointed at you, ready to fire even on the slightest suspicion that you are carrying plushies. A large incineration facility nearby burns plushies as they are intercepted, polluting the nearby environment and turning the nearby fog grey.

description.text: The Nuclear Furnace, named such due to its proximity to its star and the large radioactive mineral deposits in the crust and mantle, is a critical mining world. Most of the minerals are shipped offworld. There is no need for nuclear power, with solar panels covering up to 50% of the surface.

spaceport.text: Large ships continually offload radioactive minerals at the spaceport. The spaceport's Geiger counters continually run, creating a subtle but noticeable "white noise".

description.text: The planet of Letty acts as housing for high-ranking CSSF officials. As always, the security is near-invasive, with any plushies being burned on sight. Several thousand checkpoints operate on the roads and routes of Letty.

spaceport.text: Perhaps the most-secured part of the planet is Letty's spaceport. Large scanning equipment is present in numbers that dwarf even the strongest Republic-controlled spaceports and manual inspection of every crate is required.

description.text: Scarlet is a sparsely populated farm world. The planet supplies food for the CSSF's soldiers and officials, to allow them to continue their war against the Sayari Plushie Authority. It is rumored that Scarlet is home to a secret weapons development lab and perhaps a large stockpile of nuclear weapons.

spaceport.text: Scarlet's spaceport consists of a large grid of landing. There are large fuel tanks and hangars nearby, alongside the stuff to be expected from a normal spaceport.

description.text: Margaret is a mostly rural colony. The people here were once independent until the arrival of the CSSF. Nowadays, it is used as a penal colony where captured SPA officials reside, with the smell of burning plushies always prevalent near the prison compounds.

spaceport.text: The primary spaceport of Margaret is located on the planet's largest prison, home to 500,000 prisoners. For this reason, the spaceport's security is extremely pervasive..

description.text: Alice is home to barracks for SPA soldiers. In addition to Margaret, a large network of prisons has been built on Alice for captured SPA officials and plushie smugglers. There is not much to see here except the visitor center.

spaceport.text: The visitor center is bland and boring, with the large cities in the distance being large barracks. Large gates and security fences stand in the way, and all you can get is basic SPA propaganda, and even a place to turn in SPA products, which they consider highly illegal.

description.text: Taglamig is a tundra world. Its name means 'winter' in Tagalog, which is to be expected as the majority of Taglamig's residents are Filipino.

spaceport.text: Taglamig's population is concentrated in a single town with the only spaceport on the planet. As a planet on the very fringes of human space, it is very primitive.

description.text: Peliru is an Earth-like planet owned by the Sayari Plushie Authority. It is mostly a farming world, contributing to over 60% of the SPA's food supply.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is large and massive just like SPA spaceports in the Illumina Regions, only that it smells like food. The smells of potatoes, fertilizer, and other types of food clash against each other, enough that it could almost be worse than a chemical weapon.

description.text: Leroo Station is a pirate station in the Illumina Regions. It serves as some kind of governing building for organized pirate activity. Due to its size, pirate fleets often use this as a staging point to launch attacks on northwestern traders and occasionally the Deep. The Republic and the Deep remain baffled as to how pirates were able to obtain a large amount of Bactrians.

spaceport.text: At the docking bays, people give you weird looks, most of them being pirates. It's also possible to buy whatever you want for the right price, but this station has no stores selling slaves.

description.text: Markaai is a thriving world in the Illuria system. However, its cousin, Illumina, has a similar name, meaning people regularly confuse the two planets together. Due to this, the residents have been discussing changing the name of the system lately.

spaceport.text: Most dockworkers you see at the port have been continually annoyed at constant cargo arrivals bound for Illumina. Annoyed dockworkers aside, merchants haggle for hours on end with sellers to get the lowest possible price. In addition, Markaai is home to a large ship refurbishment company, offering various types of ships for anyone's needs.

description.text: Laateli is an Earth-like planet home to a large shipyard and over 1.34 billion people. The streets of its largest city, Laadecki is bustling with small businesses strewn across the cityscape with the occasional chop-shop. The slave trade has proliferated deep within the planet's mantle. Amongst the inhabitants, there is rumor that deep in the nearby uninhabited systems lies an entrance to an alien civillization. No explorer has been daring enough to investigate this, and it is often dismissed as mere nonsense. Due to the large shipyards here, it is a popular stopping point for captains who wish to purchase new ships or upgrades.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is busy with ships docking and undocking constantly. Air traffic controllers continue to exist, but ever since spacecraft made atmospheric-based vehicles obsolete, their main responsibility is now to control the flow of ships into the system.

description.text: Yinachr is a densely settled desert planet home to around 3.81 billion people. You are at one of the more sparse parts of the planet where the spaceport happens to be. The buildings of this part of Yinachr seem to match the color of the sand. Large deposits of important ship-building materials lie deep beneath the surface of Yinachr. In light of this, there are many mining operations on this planet and most of the residents here are either miners or their families, with the exception of the occasional rich person who you assume is one of the supervisors. Another part of the planet that seems to trigger you is the immense temperature differences between day and night (59 & -77 C respectively).

spaceport.text: At the spaceport, which is quite small for the planet's size, is overcrowded and extremely hot to the point where you would want to wear your temperature-controlled environment suit. At one section of the spaceport, there seems to be construction work going on which you hope is a temperature control system for the whole place.

description.text: Pedinai is a forest world. Over 80% of the planet's land consists solely of forests, consisting of various tree species. The largest settlement on Pedinai is home to the spaceport and hosts most of the planet's population of 14 million. The planet is home to a large lumber industry, supplying lumber to most of human space to provide the Paradise Planets and anyone with the right amount of money with wooden furniture.

spaceport.text: Merchant ships often stop by the area to purchase large amounts of lumber to sell to the Paradise Planets. Most of the dockworker's equipment seem to be specialized for carrying wood, and only wood. At least one section of the spaceport is made out of wood, from what you could discern when you landed.

description.text: Merschre is another Earth-like planet held by the Sayari Plushie Authority. 40% of the planet is a nature reserve, and the remaining land is mainly for agricultural use, as one of the planets that maintain the SPA's active supply of food. Crops grown here range from wheat, rice, to more obscure crops such as native fruits and vegetables.

spaceport.text: The Merschre spaceport is relatively large. Many of the traders here sell food. The main spaceport, Merschre Central, is one of the busiest in the Illumina Regions, rivalling that of Laateli. There are several landing pads, some of them are unusually large, to accommodate the SPA's favorite ship, the Amidala. Most of the people here are farmers, as far as you can tell from their clothing. In addition to Merschre Central, there is a large SPA-controlled shipyard selling many types of ships.

description.text: Khoramelia is the headquarters of the Sayari Plushie Authority, one of the major powers of the Illumina Regions. Its main enemy, the CSSF, has surprisingly stayed out of this area. You do wonder why the Republic has not taken any action regarding this battle, considering their role as a peacekeeping organization. You're in one of the few spaceport complexes open to the general public, but even here you can still purchase a few ships and some decent outfits.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is full of ships decked out in the livery of the Sayari Plushie Authority, but you can see a few merchant ships, if any. Most of the SPA officers ignore you, as they mind their own business trying to command the fleets of the Sayari Protection Fleet,the SPA's naval wing, which reportedly consists of 3-6,000 capital ships, far outnumbering the Republic Navy.

description.text: The mission office is located here. As you walk through the ornate halls, you find a large room containing several boards with jobs of different kinds.

spaceport.text: There are many drones at the docking bay alongside small ships.

name: Khoramelia Mission Office
_internalId: Lemurias Extra ES Stuff/Lemurias-Extra-ES-Stuff::Khoramelia Mission Office

description.text: Whereas Khoramelia is the headquarters of the Sayari Plushie Authority, its main fleet yard is located here, on Rodoluki. Even far away from the spaceport, you can hear the noise of repulsor engines and ships as they make their way out of the atmosphere into orbit, and eventually to be destroyed in battle against the CSSF.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is so loud that you were stopped and boarded by a SPA ship, during which you and your crew were all instructed to wear ear protection before coming this close to the spaceport. The officer claimed that the spaceport noise levels can go as high as 120 decibels. The spaceport is designed with extensive soundproofing, such as unusually thick walls, special frequency emitters to cancel out ship sound waves, and traffic limits. Thankfully, the situation seems to be slowly improving here.

description.text: Mindai seems to be the manufacturing hub of the Sayari Plushie Authority. The smog on this planet is so intense that there are scrubber ships flying across the atmosphere trying to capture any smog and filter it into oxygen. Lately, many manufacturing processes have moved into orbit to fix this, but due to the fear of micrometeorites, this process has been relatively slow.

spaceport.text: Most of the attire the people here wear are usually yellow hard hats, basic t-shirts and pants, and some people look like they have not bathed in weeks, reminding you of the conditions of this planet.

description.text: Arlok is the home of the Sayari Plushie Authority's research facilities. Here, experimental technology of all kinds are experimented on and reverse-engineered. Outside the laboratories, the place is relatively pristine however there are plans to move most of the labs to somewhere else since SPA fleets have to cross through Republic space to get here.

spaceport.text: Arlok's spaceport is relatively large, with landing pads strewn across the surface of what seems to be a total land area of 1.32 square kilometers.

description.text: Lorok is an Earthlike planet home to a sizable SPA presence. From what you see, it looks like this place is engaged in the manufacture of most of the SPA's products, like Sayari plushies.

spaceport.text: Contrary to the other SPA planets, this one is relatively tame, with the ship traffic mostly composed of freighters and smaller ships. The escorts here are comprised of mostly smaller ships.

description.text: Located north of Mindai, Melisida is yet another SPA colony. Similar to Mindai, it is a manufacturing and mining colony. Outside of the main city, there are many smaller mining villages home to massive equipment and hundreds of workers each.

spaceport.text: The spaceport here is incredibly boring, with not much to admire except for the ships. You see several containers of Sayari plushies being loaded on the ships, alongside the occasional 'prototype' plushies, most of whom seem to depict a woman named 'Freya Winters'.

description.text: Ekarai is a Sayari Plushie Authority colony. With a population of 45.43 million, Ekarai is a relatively large colony, rivalling the capital Khoramelia, in size. Shipyards and outfitters here sell common ships and outifts used by the Sayari Plushie Authority.

spaceport.text: The shipyard is integrated with the main spaceport. At the bench where you are sitting, a well-dressed salesman is pitching a lifesize Freya Winters plushie to a group of parents and their children who are clearly wearing party hats.

shipyards.name: Sayari Advanced without Falcon
shipyards.internalId: Lemurias Extra ES Stuff/Lemurias-Extra-ES-Stuff::shipyard:Sayari Advanced without Falcon

description.text: Renpaya is a relatively boring savannah world. This world is held by the Sayari Plushie Authority mainly to prevent it from falling into the hands of the CSSF.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is primitive, containing only the basic essentials. There are a few food shops offering food and water, and tourists who wish to explore the planet's relatively pristine nature.

description.text: Denchrao is a large and urbanized world with several cities scattered over the many continent. Rather strangely, 55% of the planet is land, whereas the average proportion of land to water on other planets was far lower, somewhere between 30 to 40%. Outside of the cities, the nature is surprisingly pristine and is well-preserved and catalogued.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is located in the largest city on Denchrao. Businesspeople in suits can be seen conversing with SPA officers and carts full of plushies, either depicting Sayari, or Freya Winters.

description.text: This is a moon of the gas giant named Kestrix. Piracy runs rampant here on this world, and many pirates here have their guns pointed at you. Kestrix I is the most run-down of the three, where crews subservient to the inhabitants of Kestrix II and III live and toil. Arbitrary executions for even the smallest of mistakes are routine here, and no mercy is given.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is rundown and the conditions here are the worst of the other Kestrix moons. Food here is overpriced and sold by men who look like they're from either Kestrix II or III. Occasionally, one of the locals attempts to steal some food, but they are mercilessly executed. You decide to ignore all of this.

description.text: This is a moon of the gas giant named Kestrix. Piracy runs rampant here on this world, and many pirates here have their guns pointed at you. Kestrix II is where most captains, either independent or bound to a warlord on Kestrix III live. This is the only moon where you can buy outfits and ships. The captains here are actually willing to trade with you, even the pirates.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is quite decent here compared to Kestrix I and III, considering Kestrix II is where most of the Kestrix Moons captains live. The outfitters are willing to sell you some basic outfits, including the notorious nerve gas.

description.text: This is a moon of the gas giant named Kestrix. Piracy runs rampant here on this world, and many pirates here have their guns pointed at you. Kestrix III is the more populous planet of the three. None of the pirates here want to trade with you or sell you even the most basic of outfits. Most of the pirates here are big and rich pirate warlords while lower-class crew and captains reside on Kestrix I and II respectively. There are many crew here who normally would belong on Kestrix I or on Leroo Station. You do meet a few friendly merchant captains who want to trade.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is rundown and the conditions are almost inhuman. Well-dressed men (likely rich pirates) sit at their tables as poorer-looking men and women bring them plates full of food. There is a field hospital here, but it is relatively empty, and it is likely the only medical care facility in the Kestrix Moons.

description.text: Eisei is the home of the Anime Organization, the predecessor state to the Sayari Plushie Authority. Their mandate has always been the preservation of anime. Anime screenings occur often on this world. As for the planet itself, the land-to-water ratio is similar to Earth, with a large desert covering 43% of the main continent. The coastline is heavily urbanized, and it appears the Anime Organization calls the shots on this world, with little interference from the Republic or Free Worlds.

spaceport.text: The main spaceport is large. Advertisements for anime screenings litter the walls, while bookstores tout their 'new mangas' in stock. This is as 'Japanese' as the spaceport can get. Flags which look like red circles on white backgrounds adorn some of these bookstores.

description.text: Massive thrusters have been mounted on the ring, to prevent its orbit from destabilizing.

spaceport.text: Most of the industrial storage area is separated from the spaceport hallways by thick glass. It appears that the Authority is proud of this particular storage system.

description.text: Anna's World (formally known as Aixafer VIII) is a gas giant. The planet got its name when Anna Fangvin, an author whose books saw moderate success on nearby Denchrao, revealed that she repeatedly traveled here to seek inspiration for her book, 'Beyond the Hyperdrive'. A small station exists in orbit, selling Fangvin's books, without providing basic spaceport services.

Lethmith is a popular place for orbital funerals. Relatives leave the bodies, remains, or ashes of their fallen loved ones in orbit around this world, to forever orbit Lethmith, until the container's orbit decays. Sometimes, Lethmith is used as a starting point to launch remains into interstellar space.

Defal VI Station high above, you find yourself deep in the gas giant below. Some deuterium collectors are high above you, deactivated at the moment until the SPA decides if it wants to scale up Defal VI Station into a full-blown refinery.

Pechara is a gas giant that was expelled from its star system hundreds of millions of years ago. Why it is linked to the hyperlane network remains unknown, but it has since been the subject of research. The nearby Pechara High station keeps an eye on the station.
Eteristra is an undeveloped planet in the Pelitol Cluster. Eteristra acts primarily as a nature reserve.

spaceport.text: The spaceport here is primitive, with very few landing pads. Most traffic into the planet descends into the atmosphere to land in places far away from the spaceport, presumably to record the planet's wildlife (of which a sizable chunk was imported from Earth).

description.text: Delistra is an undeveloped colony. Oratelis is of significant research interest however, so this planet is used as a hub for swarms of Surveillance Drones to enter space and scan the other planets.

spaceport.text: The spaceport does not have much room for normal ships, but there are plenty of automated surveillance drone swarms.

description.text: Moristra is the northernmost colony in the Pelitol Cluster. Moristra is primarily an agricultural colony with the exception of the spaceport city, where the farmer's market resides (it takes up over 75% of the spaceport city's space).

spaceport.text: Moristra's spaceport is home to the farmer's market, where farmers sell their crops and the occasional tractor salesman approaches you, and asks if you want one. Notably, Moristra has very strong right-to-repair laws for tractors and farm equipment, so there are countless facilities where farmers modify their equipment or watch as repairmen, experienced or not, repair their equipment.

description.text: Even deeper into the Pelitol Cluster, is the planet of Kaistra. Kaistra is an even smaller outpost, a mere mining colony.

spaceport.text: Kaistra's spaceport consists of a few landing pads, and the minimum required facilities.

description.text: This is an outpost. With more migration to the Pelitol Cluster, the SPA is discussing plans to convert this into a fuel generation factory, leeching off Defal VI, the gas giant that this outpost orbits. The station, located in the rings of Defal VI, is equipped with cannons on all sides to protect the station from asteroid impacts.

spaceport.text: As standard procedure, there are fuel pumps. Not many people are here, and you feel like you're in a distant region of space. There is only one ship docked. The crew seem friendly and even let you view one of their plushies. Even in remote space, Freya Winters plushies run rampant.

name: Defal VI Station
_internalId: Lemurias Extra ES Stuff/Lemurias-Extra-ES-Stuff::Defal VI Station

description.text: The planet's surface consists of a single Pangaea-style continent. The northern hemisphere of the planet is home to the majority of the population; the landscape becoming more rural and less urbanized as one goes south. A medium-sized city surrounds the spaceport, which is unusual as the surrounding region is mostly barren and uninhabited.

spaceport.text: Near the spaceport, there is a large shopping center where all types of items can be bought. It is also a place where merchants and freight captains constantly haggle over the price of commodities. A large warehouse operated by the Sayari Plushie Authority takes up roughly one-third of the shopping center's space. As usual, it is used for plushie storage.

description.text: In the planet's orbit, there are a few hundred orbital turrets which are derelict and abandoned; leftovers from Bardanistra's resistance. They are not enough of a nuisance to the planet's orbital volume yet as to warrant a salvage operation.

spaceport.text: This spaceport is large; but the SPA military base is thrice as large. It is locked behind a tall electric fence and anti-ship turrets.

description.text: Perechra is an Earth-like world and the easternmost world in the Pelitol Cluster. With a population of 12,000, the world's facilities are primitive and meet only the barebones basic standards of medicine, hygiene and other critical services. Perechra is most often used as a rest stop for ships making their way to either Kaistra or Salistra.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is barebones, with just 5 landing pads for large ships. You see 4 small ships on one of the landing pads. People here give you weird looks, since not many people land often. Dental offices, shopping centers, and even a small hospital are visible from where you currently are.

description.text: Salistra is an Earth-like world in the Pelitol Cluster. Salistra is primarily a farming, manufacturing, and shipbuilding world. Salistra is home to the Salistra Shipyard in orbit. The colony of Kaistra in the neighboring Sarut system is the Salistra Shipyard's primary source of material.

spaceport.text: The Salistra Spaceport is located on an island in the middle of one of Salistra's large oceans.

description.text: Pondar is a colony in the southern parts of the Pelitol Cluster. It was settled roughly during the 26-27th centuries with 300 colonists. Today, Pondar is now home to 9,210 people and serves as a hotspot for pirate and CSSF activity. The CSSF and pirate warlords operate their own bases on Pondar.

spaceport.text: Pondar's spaceport is one of three ports on this planet. The other ports belong to the CSSF and pirate warlords respectively.

description.text: Aylar is a small SPA-owned rest stop with less than 500 people.

spaceport.text: Your ship is refueled by the workers. Food is available at the spaceport for cheap.

description.text: Voreo is a Republic outpost, presumably to keep an eye on the activities of the Sayari Plushie Authority in the Pelitol Cluster. It's unclear how they are able to circumvent the patrols of the Sayari Plushie Authority, though.

spaceport.text: Voreo's spaceport is designed more for large ships. Soldiers and officers in Republic uniforms dominate the landscape, but thankfully are nice enough to refuel and repair your ship at no cost.

description.text: Barachen's factories rival the factories of Zarkxaa in the production of Sayari plushies and merchandise. If Zarkxaa was to be occupied, Barachen would only need to increase its production to make up for the lost supply.

spaceport.text: Meanwhile, the spaceport village offers several services such as food, drinks, ship repairs, and most importantly, plushies of either Freya Winters or Sayari. The traffic at the spaceport is fairly light with a ship entering roughly every 4 minutes.

description.text: Naprai is a large urban colony. Cities of hundreds of thousands of people are spread out across the surface. It is estimated that the city currently hosts over 132 million people. Naprai is primarily known for having a higher concentration of technology startups; the local government is sometimes forced to perform orbital cleanup operations in the rare chance that an experiment goes wrong either due to random chance or negligence.

spaceport.text: Naprai's spaceport is located outside of its largest city. Several large turrets are positioned outside the spaceport in the rare event that a piece of falling space debris from a failed experiment seems likely to hit the surface.

description.text: Ancherum is a farming planet. The vast majority of Ancherum's land is used for cotton farming, supplying material critical to plushie production. The rest of the land is simply used for growing and storing food with small villages peppered across the landscape.

spaceport.text: Ancherum's spaceport and the main farmer's market are physically in the same building.

description.text: The majority of Parton is a large nature reserve. Rumors are that this place serves as a place for top-secret SPA experiments. The planetary government refuses to confirm or deny these. While Parton is an urban colony, the settlements are mostly underground.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is located in one of the planet's valleys; the inhabitants of the spaceport village residing in a large network of caves. In one of the larger cave entrances near the spaceport, there is an outfitter and shipyard.

description.text: Heine is a planet of large farms and wheat fields. Over 80% of Heine's arable land is under the control of a single agricultural cooperative, known as the Heine Farming Federation. Unlike other planets where multiple cooperatives compete for domination over a planet's farmers, Heine's agricultural cooperative has dominated most of the planet. Other competing cooperatives were absorbed into the HFF or shut down a long time ago.

spaceport.text: As with many farming planets, the farmer's market is what uses up the vast majority of the spaceport's space and docking pads (for exports and imports). The only spaceport on Heine is under the control of the HFF, and they give priority to ships moving crops over ships carrying other types of cargo.

description.text: The Hidalgo Shrine, in orbit of Heine, is a planetwide museum of French history. The servers here have been continually running since 2871, surviving the war when the SPA split off from the Anime Organization.

spaceport.text: Nobody knows why it's called the Hidalgo Shrine.

description.text: Sparley is another Republic colony. Large settlements referred to as "favelas" (plural) dominate the vast majority of the landscape, except for the land near the spaceport, a few nature reserves, and the planet's large mountain ranges.

spaceport.text: The spaceport city is the only non-favela part of Sparley. The spaceport building is roughly octopus-shaped, with several landing pads for many different variants of ships near the spaceport's tentacle-like appendages.

description.text: Mirdenheim is a heavily urbanized colony bordering the SPA colony of Defal, with a population of roughly 898 million. Mirdenheim is one of the major colonies in the Pelitol Cluster and is home to a major Navy base and a forward operating base for conducting surveillance on the nearby Sayari Plushie Authority colonies.

spaceport.text: Mirdenheim's spaceport is at the outskirts of the largest city on Mirdenheim, and is right next to the shipyard. Large turrets are placed on the shipyard and spaceport buildings to guard against pirate attacks.

description.text: 60% of the surface of Martieu is an ocean. The remaining 40% has been subject to urbanization and deforestation.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is connected to a large shopping center, where most of the commerce occurs.

description.text: Kabegan is home to the highest concentration of datacenters in the Pelitol Cluster. Data storage devices are some of the cheapest in the Pelitol Cluster, and has some of the strongest privacy laws in the Republic. Media may be assigned an age-appropriateness rating and censored on other worlds, but not on Kabegan, which has no rating system in place for all forms of media.

spaceport.text: There are dorms at the spaceport and a small village nearby. However, most of the settlement surrounding the spaceport is connected physically to the spaceport building itself. The dorms within the spaceport are likely reserved for the spaceport workers.

description.text: Tarsia is another one of the developed and heavily urbanized planets of the southeast parts of the Pelitol Cluster. Tarsia is home to a significant SPA presence, though not enough for this planet to be governed outright by them. Tarsia is home to a large SPA distribution center, which is responsible for the sale and distribution of all plushies in the southeast Pelitol Cluster.

spaceport.text: Tarsia's spaceport is in a way, similar to Earth's spaceport. Serving a city of roughly 75 million people, most parts of the spaceport are dilapidated except for the private terminal reserved for the rich and famous. Some slave shops are likely operating within the deeper, more hidden parts of the spaceport.

description.text: The forest surrounding the city is home to several native species of trees. It is for this reason that ships are inspected closely for the presence of any invasive species.

spaceport.text: The spaceport on Taraz is located in a small exclave surrounded by the nature reserve. From space, a line of deforested land can be seen running between the spaceport and the Taraz metropolitan area. This strip of land is the only major route and is high traffic with a large team of air traffic controllers coordinating spaceship traffic along the route.

description.text: The culture of Gura is mostly influenced by Japanese culture. Gura is a colony of hundreds of millions.

spaceport.text: Gura has several spaceports scattered along the equator in place of a single large spaceport. Several industrial complexes on the surface have their own spaceport facilities.

description.text: Pareia is a large planetwide nature reserve. Most of the planet's species are imported from Earth. Small groups of Amish reside on this relatively undeveloped planet in the areas open to settlement.

spaceport.text: Pareia's spaceport is primitive. Not many ships land here on the very few landing pads available, which even then are simple concrete pads, instead of more advanced high-tech landing pads used on other worlds.

description.text: Steirek is a militarized world. It is for the exclusive use of the Sayari Plushie Authority. Steirek consists of a large network of warehouses, datacenters, and supercomputers providing storage for plushies and data and computing power to help the SPA choose the best place to sell plushies based on its models of the galaxy, which rival that of the Syndicate.

spaceport.text: The vast majority of the ships leaving and entering the spaceport are in the livery of the Sayari Plushie Authority and your ship sticks out amongst the crowd. Containers full of plushies can be seen being loaded onto the ships. The spaceport is defended by hundreds of turrets to protect against CSSF and pirate intrusions.

description.text: Ponarai is a relatively undeveloped world. The Sayari Plushie Authority has imported several species from Earth onto this world; modifying the biosphere in hopes of finding a new material that can be used to produce plushies.

spaceport.text: Ponarai's spaceport is fairly primitive; some ships can even be seen directly on the ground; without a landing pad.

description.text: Narchrai's population density is unusually high. Untouched grasslands and forests still cover over 90% of the surface, the remaining 10% being a single continuous metropolitan area home to large buildings. Collectively, these large buildings host roughly hundreds of millions of people.

spaceport.text: Narchrai's primary spaceport is located atop the city's tallest building. The immense size of the spaceport shrouds the nearby buildings into darkness for a few kilometers extending out from the center.

description.text: Pechara High is sparsely populated. Only roughly 40 people live here to maintain the station and perform research. It orbits the gas giant Pechara, which was expelled from its star system likely hundreds of millions of years ago. An even bigger mystery is why the hyperlane network would lead to such an isolated and lonely gas giant.

spaceport.text: The spaceport consists primarily of equipment for launching scientific probes alongside standard refuelling facilities.

description.text: The Brigantium Computing Array, while primarily used for scientific research, has had a part of its computing power rented out for a variety of purposes such as rendering of extremely high-quality images and movies, simulation of galactic trade prices and combat simulations. Over 99.8% of Brigantium's permanent population consist of people who maintain the Array alongside their families and close relatives.

spaceport.text: Many PC shops here sell parts taken from decommissioned Array servers, alongside prebuilt machines using the very same parts.

description.text: Lattice is primarily an upscale colony, with the vast majority of the population being either rich or retired. Most of the planet's poorer population originate from the other parts of the Pelitol cluster; it is essentially an enclave of the Paradise Worlds.

spaceport.text: The spaceport of Lattice contains many luxury stores, most of which are prohibitively expensive.

description.text: Bredehoft is an Earth-like planet with a roughly 1:1 ratio of land and water.

spaceport.text: Aside from the court, the spaceport is closely integrated with the planet's largest city, home to roughly 30% of the population.

description.text: Couric is a Pirate world, used as a rallying point for attacks against the Republic or the Sayari Plushie Authority to the west. The vast majority of Couric is controlled by a single syndicate. First landed on by a local pirate warlord known as Raugan in 2994 in an attempt to evade pursuit.

spaceport.text: Couric has no single spaceport; spaceports are spread out across the planet for redundancy in the event of a hostile planetary attack.
